title: scrophularia variegata subsp. pinardii
intro: Scrophularia variegata subsp. pinardii, commonly known as Creeping Figwort, is a perennial plant belonging to the figwort family (Scrophulariaceae). It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its reported health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Creeping Figwort include expectorant and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential remedy for conditions like bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
